platform.research: Genesys2 / CVA6 / 4 iDMA / RISC-V IOMMU / Linux

gates.name: source_and_interface
gates.entry: One frozen task/owner/full bytes/dependencies and a legal source-supported resource/interface scope.
gates.accept: Actual native path evidence for native claims; an explicit FPGA-oriented controlled projection may use existing real hardware path evidence, source-supported actors and declared model assumptions. No complete public native performance package required.
gates.failure: Unknown or incompatible key path/dependency yields exact conditional/not-applicable verdict, not a universal negative.

gates.name: G0_bounded_ordinary_loss_judgment
gates.entry: Source/interface and key causal dependencies admissible; a specific falsifiable performance hypothesis and fixed metrics. An already measured residual is not required.
gates.work: One frozen matched ordinary suite; distinguish functional success, performance comparison and translation attribution. Register once and reuse those same valid measurements; no separate duplicate pre-G0 experiment.
gates.advance: Concrete reachable avoidable translation loss remains after executable ordinary controls with costs adequate for this evidence level.
gates.stop: Measured ordinary coverage closes this performance claim. Missing causal dependency is projection-not-applicable; missing fact stays unknown.

gates.name: G1_mechanism_screen
gates.work: Two distinct bounded new information/action directions, accurate prior/ordinary comparison, costs, positive and adjacent counterexample; select one before prototype.

gates.name: prototype_and_FPGA_key_validation
gates.entry: Selected mechanism and decisive model evidence justify implementation.
gates.work: Minimal prototype, safety/ordering/drain/error acceptance, resource/timing cost, FPGA CVA6 CPU vs iDMA comparisons as relevant.
gates.early_board_exception: Only a bounded board fact that changes the current feasibility or decision; no full hardware port/build merely to rescue an unsupported idea.

cost_evidence_levels.screening: Named allocations/resources, known limits, engineering prerequisites and cost categories; unknown numeric costs remain null.
cost_evidence_levels.model_G0: Measure complete fixed-work model timing/traffic/resources and attributable ordinary costs; separate host/instrumentation, do not present unmodeled board costs as measured.
cost_evidence_levels.prototype_FPGA: Close actual mapping/cache/software supply/consumer/drain/conversion/teardown and hardware area/timing costs, native scope only when supported.

metrics.hardware_buffer_ready: Per-flow actual copy completion; explicitly not guest application receipt.
metrics.application_delivery: Original posted buffer/header/used/consumer/release boundary; report modeled/timed/unmodeled parts.
metrics.all_work_complete: All useful work and final drain, without truncating other flow.
metrics.other_flow_progress: Completed useful full packets/bytes at each flow's completion, not raw partial DMA byte count alone.
metrics.deadlines: Only if original task supports them; none invented here.

C117R3.role: Provisional validation carrier, not yet fixed paper main scene.
C117R3.first_action: One directed peer/readiness/lifetime/legally mapped resource check plus global-quiet causal preservation verdict.

schedule: About two weeks is the original aggregate topic-screening window, not a fresh window per stage; account actual work and conclude each round.
